description: Clarion Assistant hooks. SessionStart: one Node check that offers a git baseline and a CodeGraph index when the folder holds a .sln, and prints nothing otherwise. PreToolUse: safety-hook.js blocks dangerous commands and protects secrets and credentials, registered once for every tool it inspects. Both are advisory under their timeout: Claude Code cancels a command hook that reaches its timeout and drops its output, and a timed-out PreToolUse hook does not block the tool call (it goes on through the normal permission flow). The scripts themselves finish in well under a second; the timeouts leave room for node to start on a busy machine (GH #294).
